text:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — we found a last-minute telemetry dependency mismatch that affects SDK v1.4 and the sample apps. Need a very short sync on ownership and cutoffs. Changelog cutoff still 18:00 PT today, but if we have to patch sample apps we may need to delay docs merge by ~30m.

Priya R: Ack. Which dep exactly? can we vendor a shim? :thinking_face:

Jamie L: It's `@redwood/telemetry` 2.x -> 3.x. SDK v1.4 pins 2.x. PR #482 upgrades SDK to accept 3.x but requires sample apps to bump.

Sam T: I have a sample app PR ready (https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/501) but it currently fails the smoke due to telemetry init change.

Alex K: Plan proposal: Jamie merge #482 to the release branch, Sam rebase #501, Lia run quick smoke tests, Priya hold docs merge until smoke green. If smoke fails, rollback SDK change and cut a patch. Agreed? :point_up:

Jamie L: I can merge to release branch now but will tag it as "needs-sample-update" and add a short migration note.

Sam T: Will rebase and push fixes in ~20m. Quick patch: replace `Telemetry.init(config)` with `Telemetry.start(config)` in sample apps.

Lia Q: I can run smoke in staging and run the focused checklist: `npm ci && npm run build && npm run smoke`. Will post logs.

Alex K: devex-bot schedule: smoke-run at +30m? @devex-bot can you queue it for staging? :robot_face:

devex-bot: Scheduled smoke job for sample-apps PR 501 on staging in 30 minutes. Link: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/9832 :white_check_mark:

Priya R: Docs owners: I will freeze changelog entries after Lia posts smoke-green. If Lia posts failures, I will hold.

Eng Oncall: tagging infra — if smoke hits unexpected infra flakiness, call me.

Sam T: pushed fixes. snippet of the change:```
{"replace": "Telemetry.init(config)", "with": "Telemetry.start(config)"}
```

Lia Q: Running now. If you want quick local replicate: `git fetch origin pull/501/head:pr-501 && npm ci && npm run smoke`

Lia Q: smoke log summary: startup error fixed, two flakey tests still failing (timeout on /auth). Investigating, but core flow works. posting CI link: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/9832/logs

Alex K: Great — Priya, you can merge changelog once sample-apps PR is green or tests marked flaky with ticket. Jamie please leave migration note in SDK changelog. Sam file an issue for the /auth flakes and link it from PR.

Jamie L: Will add the migration note and a small inline comment in #482.

Sam T: Filed issue https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/issues/223 — noted flaky auth tests and steps to reproduce.

Priya R: Ok merging docs changelog in 10m. Thanks all. :tada:

Alex K: Closing loop — owners: Jamie (SDK), Sam (sample apps), Priya (docs), Lia (smoke). If anything regresses, revert the SDK merge and we do a point release.

Sam T: ack.

Jamie L: ack.

Lia Q: ack, will monitor post-merge smoke.
